items.name: Serve catalog item pictures
items.detail: Returns the picture file of a catalogue item with a MIME type taken from its extension.

items.name: Sign in and sign out with OpenID Connect
items.detail: Signs users in and out through OpenID Connect when Azure Active Directory is enabled.

items.name: Daily discount banner
items.detail: Shows the discount valid today with its percentage and end date on the catalogue screen.

items.name: Browse the catalog with brand and type filters
items.detail: Lists items in the WinForms client and filters them by brand and type, where 0 means all.

items.name: Check and record stock for an item on a date
items.detail: Records a stock shipment for an item on a date and searches available stock for an item and date.

items.name: Record a stock shipment
items.detail: The stock record is saved or updated and the form is cleared.

items.name: Open the catalog screen
items.detail: The form shows the discount banner, the catalog items with discounted prices, the brand and type filters and the shipment entry list.

items.name: Check available stock for an item on a date
items.detail: A row with the date, item id and quantity is added to the stock result list.

items.name: Application start of the MVC web site
items.detail: The container, routes, filters and bundles are registered, the database initializer is set when mock data is off, catalog images are initialised and telemetry is configured.

items.name: Request a catalog item picture
items.detail: The image bytes are returned with a MIME type, or an error status is returned.

items.name: Handling an HTTP request
items.detail: The request is answered by a static file, an MVC action, or the error page.

items.name: Show a page of the product catalog
items.detail: The product list shows one page of catalog items with working Previous and Next links.

items.name: Error page
items.detail: Tells the user that an error occurred while processing the request.
